claim: Try a sample archive in one click; sample data is not saved as your run history.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert seeded result, demo namespace, no real run-history database, and same-origin requests

claim: Files stay in this browser and Photo Exit Bundle does not ask you to sign in to Google.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert the no-sign-in copy and that the full sample flow makes only same-origin requests

claim: Pairs Google metadata, motion companions, and album membership in the sample archive.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert the sample photo, paired status, motion count, and album

claim: Reads a Google Takeout ZIP or an extracted folder in the browser.
where: landing product promises, file picker, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; inspect a generated Takeout ZIP, then a generated extracted folder, and assert both produce downloadable reports

claim: Exports the sample archive report as CSV.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; download CSV and assert its header and both sample media rows

claim: Complete CSV and JSON reports are free and include every sample media path plus review items.
where: landing first screen, report actions, paid section, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with no license; download both reports and assert every media row plus the unclassified review item

claim: Copies sample media bytes unchanged into the archive ZIP.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; download archive ZIP and compare the seeded media payload byte-for-byte

claim: Builds dated folders and album lists from the sample Takeout archive.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; download archive ZIP and assert a dated media path and album CSV

claim: The archive ZIP includes CSV and JSON reports, a portable README, unchanged selected Google JSON, and unclassified files for review.
where: archive build options, how it works, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; inspect the downloaded ZIP entries and README contents

claim: Reports identify missing metadata, missing motion companions, probable duplicates, unreadable JSON, and unclassified files.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with a generated review fixture; assert each issue in the UI and downloaded JSON report

claim: Builds the sample archive directly into a chosen folder in supported Chromium browsers.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with a recorded File System Access directory; assert dated media bytes and an album list are written

claim: Archive builds are free for up to 250 media items; complete reports remain available above that limit.
where: archive limit message, paid section, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; build and inspect a 250-item ZIP, then inspect 251 items and assert reports work while archive build is gated

claim: A $19 one-time Exit Pass builds above the 250-item free limit and adds exact duplicate matching.
where: landing facts, Exit Pass section, README
sandbox: fresh browser context with a recorded valid-license response; assert the price, SHA-256 exact-match result, and an enabled build above the free limit

claim: Real runs store only aggregate summaries in IndexedDB; Clear run history erases them.
sandbox: fresh browser context entered through /demo; start for real, inspect a generated fixture, assert only summary fields are stored, then clear them

claim: Loads no analytics, ads, tracking scripts, third-party runtime scripts, or CDN fonts.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; record the complete sample, theme, and reset flow, then assert every request and loaded resource is same-origin and no cookies exist

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; wait for service-worker shell cache, set offline, reload, and assert the landing h1 and offline bar
